public.text: Geographic expansion mentions primary care, community health, offline, and low-connectivity settings, but it does not include accessibility, language, private providers, displaced populations, or cross-border communities.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the last-mile criteria and require locally appropriate workflows, non-digital fallback, accessible interfaces, language support, assisted access, and inclusion of non-state providers where relevant.
